desk.headline: Revenue up 150% to ARS798.6bn; profit per share ARS97.95 vs ARS93.03; 2026 EBITDA target of $500–550m reaffirmed

numbers.eps_basis: basic and diluted GAAP (IFRS), per ordinary share

results: Revenue rose 150% to ARS798.6bn, helped by higher power prices and the Piedra del Águila hydro plant.
Operating profit rose 58% to ARS224.3bn, while net profit to shareholders rose 5% to ARS146.9bn (ARS97.95 a share).
Comparisons are rough: the power units switched to US dollar accounting from January 2026, while 2025 figures are inflation-adjusted pesos.
Cash and short-term placements rose to ARS241.2bn from ARS37.7bn at the end of 2025.

guidance.summary: On the call, management reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted EBITDA target of $500–550m and said Q4 will be weaker because of plant maintenance.

points: Management reported Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $185.3m, up from $108.8m a year earlier.
Power output rose 5.6% year on year to 4,791 GWh, with Piedra del Águila nearly doubling.
Q4 EBITDA was guided to about $75–80m because of a major overhaul at the Costanera plant.
Battery storage projects are over 80% complete and are expected to add $25–27m of EBITDA in 2027.
Net debt was $343.7m (0.72x EBITDA); no dividend decision has been made.
call.source: Central Puerto (CEPU) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — The Motley Fool, 13 Nov 2026

watch: Q4 EBITDA during the Costanera overhaul and the full-year $500–550m target.
Completion of the battery storage projects ahead of 2027.
Oil and gas plans, including the planned investment-regime (RIGI) application for new blocks.
